question: Swami Vivekananda's death anniversary is observed on ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**July 4**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Swami Vivekananda__ 

 __
 
• He was born on 12th January 1863. 
 
• He attended the parliament of religions held in Chicago on 11th September 1893.
 
• Swami Vivekananda is best known in the United States for his historic speech in the World’s Parliament of Religions held in 1893.
 
• A section of Michigan Avenue, that passes in front of the Art Institute was formally renamed "Swami Vivekananda Way" On 11 November 1995.
 
 
• Michigan Avenue is one of the most prominent streets in Chicago
 
• On 11 September 1995, Art Institute put up a bronze plaque to commemorate Swami Vivekananda's historic speech in 1893.
 
• The Art Institute of Chicago and the Republic of India reinstalled the plaque commemorating Vivekananda’s landmark speech in 2012.
 
 
 
• His birthday is celebrated as national youth day in India.
 
• The Ramakrishna Mission was founded by Swami Vivekananda.
 
• Narendranath Datta is the original name of Swami Vivekananda.
 
• He is considered the patriotic saint of India.
 
• "Go back to Gita" is a famous slogan raised by Swami Vivekananda.
 
• Every year, July 4__ is observed as the death anniversary of Swami Vivekananda.
